reply.analysis: Not closed: verdict gap, bracket [455, 534]. Lower bound 455 is a checked independent set; upper bound 534 is a checked clique cover. No linear code helped: the family rule's (2, 1) code is the right one for exact K(16,4), but on this edge-deleted graph its length was above 533, and in total 2 codes were tried. Against the baselines the agent's bracket is the tightest. cpsat_alpha also reached 455 but did not prove it (123.0 s). cpsat_cover found nothing, frac_cover gave 1800, f2_minrank_sat gave only lower 454, and kushagra_agent gave [0, 1818] in 176.7 s. Agent wall time was 142.0 s (58.7 s of it LLM time, 83.4 s compute). One suspicious point: the reported hypothesis is the first-round version (confidence 0.6), not the revised one.
